## Current Design/Behavior
Describe or show the current state. What is confusing, inefficient, or visually unappealing?

## Proposed Improvement
Describe what you think would be a better solution. How would it improve the user's experience?

## Screenshots/Mockups (Highly Recommended)
If you have them, please add screenshots of the current interface or mockups of your proposed design.

## Additional context
Add any other context about the suggestion here.
